race.comment: AUBAINE (1) ran into some good ones in his debut prep including G2 Alister Clark Stakes winner Roulette King. Has been gelded during the break and looks to have come on well. Shinn's booking adds plenty of confidence he can run well. JUST DESSERTS (7) is a Justify gelding on debut for the Hayes boys. Has jumped out sharply in readiness and is expected to make a bright start. DOLCE CAROLINA (10) will strip fitter for this after running below expectations first-up at Seymour. Likely improver but is drawn poorly. EARTHING (4) chased gamely into the placings first-up and should improve with that run under his belt. In the mix.
